name: player_toggle_flag
note: toggles byte player_info[player](DS:8bbc stride 23)+0x10+idx (0<->1); called from room handler 1581:23ca with (DAT_7a16, i)

name: trade_item_toggle
note: table DS:1aed stride 9 {int16 avail; int32 price @+2; int8 owner @+6}; owner<0 => owner+=100 (undo), else checks money_check and owner-=100 (reserve), adjusts DS:6e11[owner*0x3c] long; msg 0x2a own item; returns 1 if toggled, 0 otherwise; caller 1581:0345 (room 8) passes row*5+col

name: schedule_place_ad
c_signature: int16_t schedule_place_ad(int16_t contract_idx, int16_t hour, int16_t player)
note: copies ad-contract id (DS:1b50 + player*0x46 + idx*7) into schedule[player].ad[hour] (DS:4433 = 43f7+0x3c); returns 1 if contract slot non-empty

name: schedule_place_programme
c_signature: int16_t schedule_place_programme(int16_t archive_idx, int16_t genre, int16_t hour, int16_t player)
note: archive DS:6ef9[player][genre][idx]; checks hour already past (msg 0x2d/0x2e), length overflow (0x31), live-genre 7 date match; clears overlapped slots, fills 9999 continuation; returns 1 on success

name: schedule_clear_slot
note: schedule[player].prog[hour]=0 and .ad/aux[hour] (DS:4415)=0

name: schedule_remove_programme
note: walks back/forward over 9999 continuation slots and clears the whole block

name: programme_check_sellable
note: for current player (DS:8b88); refuses (msgs 0x33,0x35..0x39) if series in production / price 0 / film id 0x3a / flag bit / genre 7 / used in a studio production; returns 1 ok

name: broadcast_hour_tick
note: hour change -> market refill + hour_start; minute 0/5/55 phases -> ratings_calc(1/2/3); returns 1 if something happened (caller stops clock then)

name: money_check
note: balance (human: 2a62_1041, AI: player_info long @-0x743c) - amount <0 => msg 0x3b, return -1; else 0

name: studio_prepare_episode
note: studio table DS:6145 stride 16 {int16 prod_id;?;int8 owner@+3;int8 episode@+4;int8 @+5;int32 price@+6;...;busy@+0xe;pending@+0xf}; appends (prod,episode) to owner's list DS:732c (max 5, count DS:7460); msgs 0x40,0x41,0x14f; returns 1 ok

name: studio_produce_episode
note: far fn despite Ghidra 'near' + bogus param_1; computes quality from cast (productions DB DS:713c stride 0x1b3), writes film/series ratings, sets studio busy until day/hour, removes from list via 2a62_13d1; msg 0x44; returns 0/1

name: studio_rent_request
note: if studio not busy -> studio_rent(studio, player) else store pending renter (+0xf)

name: studio_release_request
note: if not busy -> studio_release else pending = 0xff

name: studio_rent
note: price += price/2 (long), charges player (human via money_add(8,amount), AI via DS:6e19 stats), sets owner, door sprites

name: studio_release
note: unfinished production moved to owner's list DS:1a25 (max 5, count DS:7652); owner=0xff; resets building door table DS:7c62+floor*0x7a (sprites 0x36/0x89/0x8a)

name: savegame_load
note: mode DS:8fb0=1 (LOAD) then savegame_serialize; main calls with 43 (initial new-game state file), 1581:4135 with 0xd1+slot

name: savegame_serialize
note: direction from DS:8fb0 (1=load,2=save); 95 calls of savegame_io; packs bitfields via stack temporaries

name: savegame_save
note: mode DS:8fb0=2 (SAVE) then savegame_serialize

name: savegame_io
note: len<0: open (load: hes_load_raw(-len) / save: alloc 40000 B, later write file -len); len==0: close/free (save: write hes_write_dgroup? + hes_write); len>0: memcpy data<->buffer at cursor DS:8fae; error flag DS:7a78

name: archive_contains
c_signature: int16_t archive_contains(int16_t player, int16_t genre, int16_t prog_id)
note: returns -1 if prog_id in archive DS:6ef9[player][genre][0..count DS:6f59), else 0
